shortDescription: IPTV player for your Xtream or M3U subscription. Live TV, movies, series, and EPG in one app.
longDescription:
Streamly is a modern IPTV front-end for your own subscription. Sign in with Xtream Codes or an M3U playlist from your provider — we do not sell channels.

• Live TV with EPG and channel guides
• Movies and series with posters and resume
• PIN pairing — link your TV from your phone without typing passwords
• TV remote-friendly layout for Samsung, LG, Fire TV, and Android TV

You need an active IPTV subscription from your provider. Streamly is the player only.
